title: AI Spokesperson Video for Product Showcases | AIVideosUGC
description: Make an AI spokesperson video where an AI-generated person holds your product up to the camera and shows it from every side. Upload a product photo to try it.
h1: AI Spokesperson Video With a Person Holding Your Product
lead: An AI-generated presenter holds your product and turns it toward the camera, so shoppers see its size in a real hand. No filming, no booking.

steps.d: Whole product in frame, with its color clear.

steps.t: Describe the presenter and the pose
steps.d: Where they stand and how they hold it, like "kitchen counter, chest height, turns it slowly".
The presenter doesn't speak. Type your message as captions.

faq.a: No. Add the message as captions in your editor after download.

faq.q: Can I describe what the person looks like?
faq.a: Yes. Include details like age range, clothing, and setting in your description. Each video is generated separately, so the person may look different from one clip to the next.

faq.q: Is the person in the video real?
Which products work well in these videos?
faq.a: Items that fit in one or two hands: skincare bottles, water bottles, phone cases, snack bags, headphones, and small purses. Large items like furniture are hard to show being held.

overview.h2: Let the presenter provide context, not a testimonial
overview.p: A presenter can show a product’s size and shape in a familiar setting. Keep the item near the center of the shot, with room for its details to show.

steps.sourceAlt: Matte forest-green water bottle standing alone on a bright kitchen counter.
steps.prompt: At a bright kitchen counter, a presenter holds this forest-green bottle at chest height and turns its blank front toward the viewer.

picker.title: Choose how a presenter shows the product
picker.lead: See a presenter turn a bottle, hold a pouch or show a small bag.

cards.label: Steel bottle beside a park bench
cards.prompt: Hold the bottle at chest height and turn it once to show its side and lid.

cards.label: Empty case with round camera opening
cards.prompt: Turn the empty sage-green case once to show its single round opening; no phone is inside.

cards.label: Snack pouch in the kitchen
cards.prompt: Raise the pouch to chest height, keeping its front visible and the face secondary.

cards.label: Handbag held at chest height
cards.prompt: Hold the handbag against a plain wall, then turn it slightly to reveal the strap.

cards.label: Headphones shown at chest height
cards.prompt: Hold the headphones at chest height, then turn them once to show both ear cups.

cards.label: Travel cup on the train
cards.prompt: Hold the cup by its handle and rotate it slowly in the window light.

cards.label: Compact portable charger held between fingers
cards.prompt: Turn the compact charger so its USB-C port is visible.

cards.label: Compact charger in vertical video
cards.prompt: Rotate the compact charger once at a bright desk, keeping its port and full shape visible.

uses.d: A product in someone's hands shows its real size better than a photo on white.
A person holding the item makes a small product easy to read in the feed.

input.good_label: Full bottle shape in clear light
input.bad_label: Bottle cap cut off at the edge
Blurred seams hide the bag shape

items: Type your message as captions. The presenter doesn't speak.
